Name: SVE Long Hair Olivia
Author: mariachaaan
Description:
[size=4]This mod replaces SVE Olivia's portraits and sprites with long-hair versions.[/size]

[size=4]⚙️ Requirements
[/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][size=4]Stardew Valley Expanded[/size][/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=4]Content Patcher[/size][/url]
[/list][list]
﻿[/list][size=4]📦 Installation[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=4]Content Patcher[/size][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] are already installed and working.[/size]
[*][size=4]Download this pack.[/size]
[*][size=4]Extract the contents into your [color=#6fa8dc]Stardew Valley/Mods[/color] folder.[/size]
[*][size=4]Launch the game through SMAPI and enjoy a long-haired version of Olivia![/size]
[/list]
